title: Thai Chicken Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai chicken stew made with chicken, saudi spices and umami flavors.

ingredients.name: saudi spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the saudi spice blend and umami sauce, stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 15-20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with chili flakes to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
